market.question: Will the highest temperature in Chicago be 51°F or below on May 1?

assessment.reasoning: Chicago O'Hare May 1, 2026 forecast shows a high of 73°F per public sources. For the high to land at 51°F or below would require a major cold front blowing in through the resolution window, well below all available forecasts. Probability ~5-12%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Late-spring Midwestern fronts can drop temperatures sharply, but going from forecast 73°F down to 51°F is a 22°F miss.
